title: Käsespätzle
description: A traditional Germany dish made with all-purpose flour, chicken egg, yellow onion, emmental. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 8 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 13 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Layer the prepared elements evenly in the baking dish, spreading filling right to the edges.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 8 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
